name: AI Drive
author: Kizi
description: Beta, races only. Press a key and the game's AI drives your car; press again to take over. Can use the AI teammate's setup and skip the pit stop button press. Needs Swofty 1.7.

options.label: Start: AI drives from the start of the race
options.description: On: the AI takes your car by itself a few seconds after the race starts. Off: you press the key yourself. Races only.

options.label: Keys: AI on/off key
options.description: Press it during a session to let the AI drive your car. Press it again to drive yourself. It only works while the game window is in front.

options.label: Keys: take-over countdown
options.description: When you press the key to drive again: right away, or after a 3 or 5 second countdown with beeps, so you can get ready.

options.label: Sound: beeps
options.description: A beep when the AI takes your car and when you get it back.

options.label: Pit: no quick-time event while the AI drives
options.description: With Immersive pit stops the game asks for a button press during the stop. The AI can't press it, so the stop came out late. On: the crew just does a normal stop.

options.label: Setup: use the AI teammate's setup while the AI drives
options.description: While the AI drives, your car gets the setup values of the AI car that is the same car (differential, brake bias, camber, toe, anti-roll, ride height, ballast). Yours come back when you take over. Wings and tyre pressures can't be changed live.
